entities.summary: Anatoly Grigor'evich Pisarenko is a former Soviet Olympic weightlifter from Ukraine. Along with Aleksandr Kurlovich, he became better known in 1985 due to the international scandal when both of them were caught by the Canadian customs in possession of steroids. Anatoly Pisarenko was a athletes & competitors from Kyiv (b. 1958-01-10, Kyiv). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
